summary: Seven relaxed days in New York: icons, neighborhoods, and one free day — no duplicated blocks and no airport repetition.

days.title: Arrival in New York and Midtown
days.travelHack: After landing at JFK, take AirTrain + subway (A) or an official taxi — Uber outside the yellow-cab stand is often pricier.
days.transportationTips: MetroCard / OMNY: tap with your card. Avoid unmarked limos in front of the terminal.

afternoon.name: Arrival at JFK and transfer to Midtown
afternoon.description: Land, collect luggage, and transfer to the hotel.
bullets: Allow 60–90 min to Midtown, depending on traffic.
Buy a SIM/eSIM at the airport if you don't have roaming.

afternoon.name: Check-in and short break
afternoon.description: Settle in and freshen up after the flight.
bullets: Drop your bags and refresh for 45–60 min.
Skip major museums today — a light intro to the city.

evening.name: Walk through Times Square and Bryant Park
evening.description: A short evening intro to Midtown.
bullets: Times Square only briefly — the crowds are part of the experience.
Dinner around Koreatown (32nd St).

evening.name: Dinner in Koreatown
bullets: BBQ or bibimbap — quick and local.
Don't book a second evening block.

days.title: Central Park and Upper West Side
days.travelHack: Buy Natural History Museum tickets online — lines stay long even in summer.
days.transportationTips: B/C to 81st St for the museum; walking is best in the park.

morning.name: American Museum of Natural History
morning.description: Classic morning museum visit while it's still quieter.
bullets: Fossil halls and Rose Center are worth 2–3 hours.
Then exit straight into Central Park.

afternoon.name: Central Park — The Mall and Bethesda Fountain
afternoon.description: Classic park core, without a rushed hop-on hop-off.
bullets: Walk from 72nd to Bethesda.
Coffee at Loeb Boathouse or a nearby café.

evening.name: Dinner on the Upper West Side
evening.description: Neighborhood dinner — less touristy than Midtown.
bullets: Columbus Ave or Amsterdam Ave.
One table, no second evening block.

days.title: Statue of Liberty and Downtown
days.travelHack: Book the Statue of Liberty ferry in advance (Crown/pedestal).
days.transportationTips: 4/5 to Bowling Green; back on R/W or 1.

morning.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
bullets: Allow 3–4 hours for both islands.
Water and a light jacket — it's windy on the water.

afternoon.name: Wall Street, Charging Bull and One World Observatory
bullets: Bull photo quickly — crowds are constant.
Observatory at sunset if you catch a slot.

evening.name: Dinner in TriBeCa / FiDi
evening.description: A quieter dinner after downtown sightseeing.
bullets: One restaurant, local cuisine or steakhouse.

days.title: Brooklyn: DUMBO and Williamsburg
days.travelHack: Cross Brooklyn Bridge on foot from Manhattan early — it gets crowded for photos later.
days.transportationTips: F to York St (DUMBO); L to Bedford for Williamsburg.

morning.name: Brooklyn Bridge walk + DUMBO views
morning.description: Walk across the bridge and photos at Jane's Carousel.
bullets: Start on the Manhattan side in the morning.
Coffee in DUMBO before continuing.

afternoon.name: Williamsburg — Bedford Ave and East River Ferry
afternoon.description: Neighborhood, thrift shops, and views back to Manhattan.
bullets: Walk to Domino Park.
Ferry back to Manhattan at sunset.

evening.name: Dinner in Williamsburg
evening.description: One Brooklyn dinner — pizza or modern American.
bullets: Reservation recommended on Fridays/Saturdays.

days.title: MoMA and Chelsea
days.travelHack: MoMA: Free Friday evenings are packed — buy a daytime ticket instead.
days.transportationTips: E/M to 5th Ave–53rd; High Line on foot.

morning.name: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
bullets: Focus: 5th floor (Van Gogh, Warhol).
Don't rush through the whole museum.

afternoon.name: High Line and Chelsea Market
bullets: High Line from 30th heading south.
Chelsea Market for lunch — pick one stall.

evening.name: Dinner in Chelsea
bullets: One table — no second evening block.

days.title: Free / local day on the Lower East Side
days.travelHack: This is intentionally a light day — no piling on icons.
days.transportationTips: F/J/M to Delancey; walk to East Village.

morning.name: Tenement Museum or walk along Orchard St
morning.description: Local history instead of another panorama.
bullets: Tenement Museum: book a tour.
Or: thrift shops + bookstores on the LES.

afternoon.name: East Village — Tompkins Square and a café
bullets: Coffee and people-watching.
Optional short visit to St. Marks Place.

evening.name: Dinner on the Lower East Side
evening.description: One dinner — dumplings, pizza, or a natural wine bar.
bullets: Reserve for popular spots.

days.title: Last morning and departure
days.travelHack: For an afternoon flight, leave the hotel 4–5 hours before departure (JFK security + AirTrain).
days.transportationTips: Taxi/Uber or AirTrain back to JFK.

morning.name: Grand Central Terminal and Bryant Park
bullets: Photo in the main concourse.
Coffee for the road.

afternoon.name: Transfer to JFK and international departure
bullets: Check out by 11:00 or store luggage.
Arrive 3 hours before an international flight.
